title: Shontel Brown criticizes Trump policies on Venezuela and veterans' care in recent tweets
text:
Shontel M. Brown U.S. House of Representatives from Ohio's 11th district | Official U.S. House Headshot
Shontel M. Brown U.S. House of Representatives from Ohio's 11th district | Official U.S. House Headshot
U.S. Representative Shontel Brown, who has represented Ohio’s 11th district since 2021, recently posted a series of tweets raising concerns about former President Donald Trump’s actions on foreign policy, veterans’ healthcare, and presidential pardons.
On January 7, 2026, Brown questioned the decision-making process behind U.S. policy toward Venezuela during the Trump administration. She stated: "Who did Trump consult when it came to attacking Venezuela and taking over the country? Not the House. Not the Senate. No, instead he talked to the oil firms who have a direct conflict of interest. This president isn't working for you. He's working for his billionaire buddies."
Later that day, she addressed reported staffing reductions at Veterans Affairs facilities under Trump's leadership. On January 7, 2026, Brown tweeted: "Trump has already cut tens of thousands of positions at the VA, with more cuts planned. I’m very worried about the impact on patient care at the Stokes VA in Cleveland and demanding answers. Because no Ohio veteran wants fewer doctors and nurses at the VA."
In another tweet from January 7, 2026, Brown criticized what she described as a pattern involving fraud among Trump allies: "Fraud seems to be top of mind for the President and his right-wing allies, which is interesting because just in the last year.. President pardoned a Florida health care executive convicted of defrauding Medicare to the tune of $205 million. Wash, rinse, repeat…"
Brown was born in Cleveland in 1975 and currently resides in Warrensville Heights. Before her election to Congress in 2021—succeeding Marcia Fudge—she served on Cuyahoga County Council from 2015 to 2021 and holds a Bachelor of Science degree from Wilberforce University.
